meta.description: Lighting plan (example garage): fixture catalogue, existing fixtures and their controls, planned layers, named plans and scenes. Space frame, inches (x east from the W wall, y north from the S wall, z up from the slab). Read by build_scene.py / render.py (drawn and lit per layout), validate.py and, if you adapt it, extras/lighting/lighting.py.

fields.fixture_types: lm = catalogue lumens, beam = degrees, peak = candela (null: estimated from lm and beam), radius = lens radius in METRES (Cycles soft shadows), dia/len = housing inches, cct = kelvin
fields.existing: installed fixtures; their positions live in data/space.json ceiling_items (shop_ref = that item's id)
fields.layers: kind existing | table | strip | puck_grid | spots | golf; strips: lm_per_ft along p0-p1, normal = the way they shine
fields.scenes: levels per layer: 0-1, or {f, cct, rgb}; ev = exposure offset for night renders

controls.note: example: the wall switch by the house door

controls.model: 0-10V or phase dimmer to match the track heads
controls.note: example: one dimmer for the bench spots and strip
